command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "### STEP 1: create backing files for loop-based PVs"
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-disks
sudo -n truncate -s 1200M /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk1.img
sudo -n truncate -s 1200M /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk2.img
ls -lh /var/lib/lvm-disks/

echo "### STEP 2: attach loop devices"
LOOP1=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk1.img)
LOOP2=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk2.img)
echo "LOOP1=$LOOP1 LOOP2=$LOOP2"
sudo -n losetup -a

echo "### STEP 3: create PV + VG + LV (start under 2G) using only first PV"
sudo -n pvcreate -ff -y "$LOOP1"
sudo -n vgcreate datavg "$LOOP1"
sudo -n lvcreate -n datalv -l 100%FREE datavg
sudo -n lvs

echo "### STEP 4: format and mount at /srv/data"
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/datavg/datalv
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data
df -hT /srv/data

echo "### STEP 5: write baseline content + checksum"
sudo -n sh -c 'dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/testfile.bin bs=1M count=200 status=none'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo hello-lvm > /srv/data/marker.txt'
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && sha256sum testfile.bin marker.txt > /srv/data.sha256sum'
cat /srv/data.sha256sum
sudo -n lsblk -f

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "### STEP 10: create systemd unit to reattach loop-backed PVs at boot"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/lvm-loop-disks.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop devices backing datavg LVM PVs
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service local-fs-pre.target
Before=sysinit.target
Requires=systemd-udevd.service
Wants=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup -f /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk1.img
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup -f /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk2.img
ExecStart=/sbin/udevadm settle
ExecStart=/sbin/vgchange -ay datavg

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
UNIT

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable lvm-loop-disks.service

echo "### STEP 11: add fstab entry by UUID"
XFS_UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/mapper/datavg-datalv)
echo "XFS_UUID=$XFS_UUID"
grep -q "$XFS_UUID" /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null && echo "fstab already has entry" || \
  echo "UUID=$XFS_UUID /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=lvm-loop-disks.service 0 2" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab

echo "### STEP 12: sanity check mount -a idempotent (should not error, already mounted)"
sudo -n mount -a
mount | grep /srv/data
systemctl is-enabled lvm-loop-disks.service
